subject.title: fix: fall back on raw provider request errors

question: Should generic cross-provider `invalid_request_error` responses advance configured model fallbacks once more-specific context, billing, auth, rate-limit, model, message, and provider rules do not apply?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused, but this choice changes whether a user-caused or provider-specific request rejection remains terminal on the selected model or moves work to another configured provider/model.

options.title: Confirm shared fallback policy
options.body: Accept the generic format mapping and let configured fallbacks handle otherwise-unclassified provider request rejections after the preserved precedence checks.

options.title: Constrain the policy
options.body: Limit failover to an explicitly approved provider/error contract if maintainers want unsupported-parameter and provider-policy errors to remain terminal.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared fallback policy
recommendation.body: Accept the generic format mapping and let configured fallbacks handle otherwise-unclassified provider request rejections after the preserved precedence checks.
